model.description: Caller-selected Model ID, Endpoint ID, or Agent Plan model name. No automatic model substitution.

temperature.description: Dimensionless sampling temperature, not degrees; supported range and default depend on the model.

top_p.description: Cumulative sampling probability as a dimensionless 0–1 value, not percent; for example 0.9 means 90% probability mass. Model-specific restrictions apply.

messages.description: Native Chat messages; content may contain text, image_url, video_url, input_audio and tool calls, as supported by the model.

max_tokens.description: Maximum generated tokens (token count, not characters or bytes); model-specific limits apply.

max_completion_tokens.description: Maximum completion tokens (token count, including reasoning where applicable); model-specific limits apply.

seed.description: Dimensionless random seed (integer), not a count or duration; allowed values and sentinel values depend on the model.

frequency_penalty.description: Dimensionless frequency-based repetition penalty coefficient; range/support depend on the model.

presence_penalty.description: Dimensionless presence-based repetition penalty coefficient; range/support depend on the model.

top_logprobs.description: Number of most likely token alternatives to include with log probabilities (count); model-specific limits apply.

logit_bias.description: Map from token IDs to dimensionless logit bias values; not probabilities or percentages. Provider limits apply.
